collection.title: BYD Seal 2023 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BYD Seal 2023 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
